content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIMB Academic Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIMB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIMB Academic Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the IIMB Academic Associate - Strategy Area post is 26 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIMB Academic Associate posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Academic Associate - Strategy Area post in the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore Recruitment 2026. This is a contract-based government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIMB Academic Associate jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIMB Academic Associate - Strategy Area recruitment is online. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Academic Associate - Strategy Area at IIMB?
faq.answer: The salary for the Academic Associate - Strategy Area position at IIMB ranges from Rs. 43,000 to Rs. 55,000 per month. This is a competitive salary for a contract-based role.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Academic Associate - Strategy Area post must hold a Master's degree in management, social sciences, statistics, economics, or commerce from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIMB Academic Associate Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIMB Academic Associate - Strategy Area Recruitment 2026. Applications are free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIMB Academic Associate?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Academic Associate - Strategy Area post at IIMB primarily involves shortlisting of candidates. Further details regarding interviews or other stages will be communicated to shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for IIMB Academic Associate?
faq.answer: The job location for the Academic Associate - Strategy Area position is Bangalore, Karnataka. This offers an opportunity to work in a premier educational institution in a major Indian city.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIMB?
faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) is where candidates can find detailed information about the recruitment and apply online. Please refer to the important links section for the direct link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for Academic Associate at IIMB?
faq.answer: The job type for the Academic Associate - Strategy Area position at IIMB is Contract. This means the employment will be for a specified period, as per the terms and conditions outlined in the official notification.
